transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I've been struggling with episodes where I eat an unusually large amount of food. It feels like I lose all control and just can't stop eating once I start.
After these episodes of overeating, do you engage in any behaviors to prevent weight gain, such as vomiting, using laxatives, fasting, or excessive exercising?
No, I don't do any of those things. I've never tried to make myself throw up, take laxatives, or force myself to fast or over-exercise afterward.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Binge-Eating Disorder, Bulimia Nervosa]. The patient explicitly denied compensatory behaviors (vomiting, laxatives, fasting, or excessive exercise), which effectively rules out Bulimia Nervosa. Therefore, the current candidate is restricted to Binge-Eating Disorder.
